description: This Java class implements the <field-to-result> element for the OFBiz MiniLang scripting language. It processes XML configuration to map a field value to a result name within a method execution context, supporting nested expressions and creating method operation instances for execution.

classes.name: FieldToResult
classes.description: Implements the <field-to-result> element, mapping a specified field value to a result in the method context, with support for nested expressions.

classes.name: FieldToResult.FieldToResultFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of FieldToResult.

methods.name: FieldToResult
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation based on XML element attributes, validating required attributes and setting up flexible map accessors.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation, retrieving a field value from the environment map and placing it into the results map, handling nested expressions if present.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the operation with its parameters.
